articles.summary: Family travel has its own packing logic. There's the bag that holds everyone's extra clothes, the bag you can reach into while boarding a plane, and the smaller one you take when the rest can stay in the hotel room. A good mix lets you carry what the day calls for without hauling the entire trip along. For Flights With Kids: Large Bancroft Backpack The Large Bancroft Backpack is a practical choice for the flight, especially when your carry-on needs to hold something for everyone. Adjustable shoulder straps leave your hands free, and the trolley sleeve lets you secure the backpack over a suitcase handle while you move through the airport. Once you've found your seats, you'll know where to look for the headphones, the coloring book, and the snack someone suddenly needs right now. Dimensions: 12.0" w x 16.5" h x 9.0" d Favorite Features: • Three compartments to separate snacks and activities from your own essentials • Front zip pocket with four slip pockets and a pen slip • Two exterior slip pockets offer room for water bottles • Separate compartment accommodates a laptop up to 15” (or coloring books!) For the Things You Need Before You Can Sit Down: Original Zip Hipster You can pack beautifully and still need your phone while your backpack is out of reach. The Original Zip Hipster gives those essentials a place closer at hand. Its slim crossbody shape works well alongside your larger carry-on item. Wear it through the airport, then take it on its own for a coffee run or an evening walk once you arrive. Dimensions: 11.0" w x 9.0" h x 2.75" d Favorite Features: • Zip closures to keep everything secure • Longer adjustable strap: 26.5" at the longest drop • Two exterior zip pockets and an interior zip pocket help separate your wallet, phone, and other small items For Sightseeing and Amusement Parks: Small Banbury Backpack A full-size carry-on doesn't need to come along for every outing. The Small Banbury Backpack gives you a compact, hands-free option for a museum, a walk through a new city, or an afternoon at an amusement park with the kids. Tons of organization options give sunglasses, a phone, sunscreen, and other small essentials their own space so every stop doesn't turn into a search through the bottom of your bag. Dimensions: 7.0" w x 11.75" h x 4.75" d Favorite Features: • Exterior: zip compartment, back slip pocket, and two side slip pockets • Two slip pockets and a zip pocket inside • Adjustable straps help you find a comfortable fit for a long day of walking For Snacks Between Stops: Lunch Crossbody A road trip picnic or a packed lunch at the park is easier when the food has its own bag. Our Lunch Crossbody has a structured, polished shape with plenty of personality. Carry it by the small handle or use the adjustable crossbody strap when your hands are occupied with everything else. Dimensions: 10.25" w x 8.5" h x 6.25" d Favorite Features: • Food-safe PEVA lining • Zip closure so nothing tumbles out • Side water bottle pocket For Short Trips: Weekender Travel Bag and 3 Pouch Organizer Set The Weekender Travel Bag has room for the clothes and extras that make all the difference for a quick family getaway. Use it to carry the kids' clothes and accessories, or fit their extras in alongside yours. With multiple ways to carry it, the Weekender Travel Bag is your flexible best friend. Dimensions: 17.75" w x 12.5" h x 8.0" d Favorite Features: • Six slip pockets in the main compartment, perfect for diapers and everything you need when traveling with a baby • Exterior front zip pocket and side and back slip pockets • Trolley sleeve to easily carry with your suitcase on longer trips • Two handles and removable, adjustable strap Pair it with the 3 Pouch Organizer Set to give small items a better chance of staying found. Use one pouch for chargers, one for toiletries, and one for the hair ties, crayons, or tiny toys that tend to migrate through a travel bag. The set includes three sizes, each with a zip closure, so you can change your system to fit the trip. For Hotel Mornings: Hanging Organizer and Hair Care Case When several people are getting ready in one bathroom, a little organization goes a long way. Our Hanging Organizer unfolds to 29.25” high, putting its pockets where you can see them instead of spreading everything across the counter. It includes a zip mesh pocket, two TPU zip pockets, and a removable TPU zip pouch. Use it to group the family's everyday toiletries, then fold it up when it's time to leave. Dimensions when folded: 10.0" w x 7.5" h x 4.0" d The Hair Care Case gives brushes, hair accessories, and styling tools their own spot. Four interior slip pockets help corral smaller items, while its exterior zip pocket has a heat-resistant silicone surface and three elastic loops for hot tools. It's a useful companion to your other travel toiletry bags when the family's getting-ready essentials need more than one pouch. For Travel With a Baby: Large Berkhill Backpack Meet your new favorite baby bag. Go hands-free with the lightweight Large Berkhill Backpack to carry everything you need for baby through airports, around theme parks, or on road trips. Reinvent the zippered laptop compartment to hold your changing pad and a few diapers, with plenty of room inside for the wipes, extra clothes, toys and anything else you need close at hand. From toddler to teenager, this is a bag you can keep carrying for trips well beyond the baby years! Dimensions: 13.25" w x 16.75" h x 8.5" d Favorite Features: • Comfortable adjustable straps leave your hands available for the stroller or a little hand that wants yours • Extremely lightweight Featherweight material weighs less than a pound when empty • Trolley sleeve to take it off your shoulders when you're also pulling a suitcase • Two exterior side pockets can keep baby bottles within reach • Two slip pockets for extra help staying organized For busy travel days, pack the changing essentials together so you can grab them without digging through the whole backpack. Our Medium Pouch can hold diapers and a travel pack of wipes, depending on their sizes. Use the Small Pouch for a pacifier and other little things that tend to disappear into a larger bag, and use the front pockets for items you'll need to reach for frequently during the journey. Both pouches zip closed and you can rearrange your system as your family's needs change. You've Got Places to Be. Bring the Right Bag! The flight, the road trip, the day at the park: each asks for something different. Take the backpack when you're carrying a little of everything, the crossbody when you want the essentials close, and the diaper backpack when the baby's supplies need their own place. You know how your family travels. Pick the bags that work for you, in colors and patterns you'll be glad to carry! SHOP ALL TRAVEL BAGS & ACCESSORIES
articles.title: The Best Travel Bags for Moms on the Go

articles.summary: You leave the hotel with a few stops in mind. By lunch, you've found a bookstore, taken more photos than expected, and decided the market across town is worth the walk. A good sightseeing bag can keep up with that kind of day. The best day bag for sightseeing gives you enough room for what you want to bring along, keeps the things you need easy to find, and feels right with what you're wearing. Here's how to choose one for the way you like to explore. Best Bag for an All-Day Itinerary When you'll be out from morning until dinner, start with what you actually plan to bring. A wallet and phone are one thing. Add a small umbrella, sunglasses, a snack, and the little things you collect throughout the day, and pockets become much more useful. Small Banbury Backpack: Room to Stay Organized The Small Banbury Backpack is a good compact bag for day trip plans that cover a lot of ground. Its adjustable straps leave your hands free for maps, photos, and whatever you pick up along the way. An exterior zip compartment keeps frequently used items separate from the main compartment, while two side pockets let you bring a water bottle or compact umbrella. Dimensions: 7" w, 11.75" h, 4.75" d "Super cute pattern and I love the lightweight material! Love the size for travel and love that you can still fit a water bottle in the side!" ~ Lauren Lorman Sling Backpack: A Lighter Way to Roam The Lorman Sling Backpack has a narrower shape for days when you're carrying less. Its convertible strap lets you wear it over your left or right shoulder, so you can choose what feels comfortable as you move through the city. Two exterior zip compartments give essentials their own spots, with a back slip pocket and a slip pocket in the main compartment to stash your phone, wallet and more. It's a great choice when you want the ease of a backpack in a slimmer style. Dimensions: 6.5" w, 11" h, 2.75" d "Very sturdy and stylish, holds just enough for a day trip or traveling." ~ Margaret Best Bag for Hands-Free Exploring A crossbody makes sense when the day involves walking, browsing, and moving between activities. How much you bring will help you decide whether you want a compact bag or more space. Becker Camera Bag Crossbody: Just the Essentials The Becker Camera Bag Crossbody is for the traveler who knows what she needs and brings exactly that. Its compact shape measures 8.25" wide, 5.5" high, and 3" deep, so it's an easy choice for a few hours of sightseeing or an evening out. A front zip pocket and back slip pocket give you places for items you reach for often; inside, two slip pockets and a zip pocket help keep your phone, wallet, keys, and small necessities in order. The adjustable strap lets you settle it where you like, and the zip closure keeps the main compartment secure between stops. Dimensions: 8.25" w, 5.5" h, and 3" d "Small, but holds the essentials I need. Love the wide strap as it sits comfortably on my shoulder." ~ Nancy Harwick Large Messenger: More Room, Same Freedom If you prefer a crossbody but want one that holds more, look to the Harwick Large Messenger bag. Its structured silhouette adds a polished touch to an outfit, while its generous size gives you more room than a compact camera bag. Harwick's front zip pocket has two slip pockets inside, handy when you want to find small items without opening the main compartment. Two back slip pockets add quick-access storage, and an interior zip pocket and two slip pockets help organize what you carry inside. It's a strong contender for the best bag for city sightseeing when your plans take you from morning coffee to an afternoon museum and on to dinner. Dimensions: 11.5" w x 11.0" h x 3.5" d "Hands free and large enough to carry whatever you may need for any occasion. Enough pockets too to make it easy to find everything." ~ Rita Best Bag for Carrying Layers, Snacks, and Souvenirs Some itineraries practically invite you to bring something home. If you're visiting markets, stopping in shops, or carrying a few extra items for the kids, a tote or roomier handbag can make more sense than a small crossbody. Check the dimensions against what you plan to carry, especially for bulkier layers or purchases. Small Original Vera Tote: A Little Extra Room Our Small Original Vera Tote is a petite version of a familiar favorite. Its clean shape works for a museum day or a market visit, while the zip closure helps keep everything together as you move between stops. Six interior slip pockets give your smaller essentials places to land, so they're easier to find when you need them. An exterior slip pocket and zip pocket add options for the things you want to reach quickly. That shape gives you some flexibility for the day's extras without asking you to carry a full-size tote. Dimensions: 11.5" h, 4.5" d, 11.5" w at its base, with a wider 16.25" opening at the top "Love the design and size. My go to purse for traveling and carrying a good book to read with me!" ~ Katrina Hathaway Reversible Tote Bag: Space and Style Options When you want maximum flexibility, step up to the Hathaway Reversible Tote Bag. It's a large capacity tote bag that's easy to carry thanks to the comfortable 12” handle drop. As an added bonus, the bag is fully reversible so you can match any outfit or occasion on your trip. No matter which side you choose, an exterior slip pocket keeps your phone and necessities easy to reach while an interior slip pocket gives an extra option for organization. The unstructured style can fit a few items secured with a hidden magnetic closure, or leave the top open for those bigger shopping finds and travel take-alongs. Dimensions: 13.0" h x 6.25" d, 13.75" w at its base, with a wider 20.5" opening at the top "Perfect size for a quick trip out shopping. Love the style." ~ Teresa Best Bag for a Day That Runs Into Dinner Sightseeing plans have a way of growing. If you'd rather keep the same bag for an afternoon of wandering and dinner afterward, choose one that fits how you want to carry it. Original 100 Handbag: The Vera Bradley Classic The Original 100 Handbag brings Vera Bradley's original silhouette along for the trip. The most organized shoulder bag you'll ever have, it features three exterior slip pockets and five interior slip pockets. This is a particularly welcome detail when you've gathered receipts, tickets, sunglasses, and the other small traces of a day well spent. Its quilted cotton lining and familiar shape give it a character all its own. With a zip closure and 13.5" handle drop, it's a lovely choice for someone who wants a classic handbag that you can throw over your shoulder comfortably. Dimensions: 11.0" w x 5.75" h x 5.5" d "This is a great bag, handles are long enough to put on your shoulder with a coat on. Great pockets inside and outside." ~ Sherrie Clara Convertible Shoulder Bag: Ready for the Next Stop The Clara Convertible Shoulder Bag has a clean, polished shape that feels at home no matter where your sightseeing day takes you. Carry it by its handles while you browse, then attach the removable, adjustable strap when you want your hands free for the walk to dinner. At 12" wide, 9.25" high, and 2.75" deep, Clara has room for your daily essentials without the bulk of a larger tote. A zip closure keeps the main compartment covered, and an interior zip pocket gives smaller items a place to stay put. Dimensions: 12" w, 9.25" h, and 2.75" d “It is so light weight and the perfect size. A really nice new thing is that both straps can be used and removed at will. It makes the bag super versatile.” ~ Iris So, Which Bag Comes With You? Choose for the day you're planning, then leave a little room for the day you might have. The Small Banbury suits a longer itinerary with more to organize. The Lorman keeps a lighter load close. Becker carries the essentials, while Harwick gives crossbody fans more room. The Small Original Vera Tote and Original 100 Handbag suit days with extra stops and a few finds; Clara moves easily into evening plans. The best bag is the one you'll be glad you brought at hour seven, when you spot one more street you want to walk down. SHOP ALL BAGS FOR DAY TRIPS
